title: Kissed Honey Fritter Moroccan Flour Jjajeek
description: A savory and crumbly Moroccan dish made with fermented ingredients and fines-herbes, served with a sweet honey glaze.
instructions: Mix flour, yeast, and salt in a large bowl.
Gradually add water and honey, stirring to form a dough.
Knead the dough for 10 minutes until smooth and elastic.
Cover the dough with plastic wrap and let it rest for 1 hour.
Preheat oil in a deep frying pan or a korean brass bowl to 350°F.
Shape the dough into small balls and flatten them into disks.
Fry the disks in batches until golden brown, about 2-3 minutes per side.
Drain the fritters on paper towels and sprinkle with sesame seeds.
Serve warm with a honey glaze made by mixing honey and ghee in a small bowl.
